Workers now emit a `drained` event when the queue is empty and no jobs are active. This release also adds `queue.purge()` as the replacement for deprecated `queue.clean()`.

## Features

- Emit `drained` when the queue runs empty and has no active jobs (#331)
- Add `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs })` to remove older jobs (#338)

## Deprecations

- Deprecate `queue.clean()` in favour of `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs })` (#338)
  Migration: Replace `queue.clean(graceMs, status)` with `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs: graceMs })`.

## Fixes

- Retry lock renewal after a Redis connection reset (#334)

## Security

# quaykit 3.1.0

Workers now emit a `drained` event when the queue is empty and no jobs are active. This release also adds `queue.purge()` as the replacement for deprecated `queue.clean()`.

## Features

- Emit `drained` when the queue runs empty and has no active jobs (#331)
- Add `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs })` to remove older jobs (#338)

## Deprecations

- Deprecate `queue.clean()` in favour of `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs })` (#338)
  Migration: Replace `queue.clean(graceMs, status)` with `queue.purge({ status, olderThanMs: graceMs })`.

## Fixes

- Retry lock renewal after a Redis connection reset (#334)

## Security

- Upgrade to address an issue in signing (#336)

## Fixes

- Retry lock renewal after a Redis connection reset (#334)

## Security

- Upgrade to address an issue in signing (#336)

item.text: Die PRs sind geprüft. Einordnung: `drained` ist ein Feature, `queue.purge()` führt eine Deprecation ein, und der Security-Fix gehört knapp unter „Security“. Damit ist mindestens Minor erforderlich; ich fasse die Notes jetzt zusammen und veröffentliche sie.
